plan.title: scope-provenance: first-adoption path + base-visible approval authority (#3205)

narratives.Description: Directive 0.97+/0.98 verify:scope-provenance has no operator-facing renewal surface and incorrectly rejects valid base-visible human approvals during pending->active activation. Single story delivers both the evaluator correction and the record-approved-scope operator path, plus docs and real-Git regressions, as one through-merge unit.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3205 (operator-approved single-story swarm through-merge; cohort open for later issues)
narratives.Overview:
## Defect (two faces, one story)

1. **Missing first-adoption / renewal surface**: library exposes `renewedApprovals` only as an evaluation/test option; CLI has no independent renewal input; remediation cites `task scope:record-approved-scope`, which is not deposited.
2. **Base-visible approval false positive**: when a valid human-approved `.deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json` already exists unchanged on the merge base, canonical `pending/` -> `active/` still hard-fails as `self-authorizing-scope-expansion` because disk-only inference reads the *active xBRIEF* from base and treats absence as approval rewrite. Multi-PR bootstrap therefore does not work.

## Expected outcome

- Authority comes from the approval record in the merge base (schema, human stamp, plan id, path, scope, digest; current record unchanged vs base).
- Operator can mint/re-record digests via a real `scope:record-approved-scope` (or equivalent) surface.
- First-adoption flow documented for consumers whose active story + gate land together.
- Real-Git regressions cover pending->active, missing/mismatched approval, same-PR rewrite fail-closed, expansion beyond base fail, separate approval-then-expand pass, and independent `renewedApprovals` still supported.
- Fail-closed posture preserved (no self-auth bypass).

## Related
- Parent feature: #3145 (closed)
- Module: packages/core/src/scope-provenance/, packages/cli verify-scope-provenance, tasks/scope.yml + tasks/verify.yml, content/docs/scope-provenance.md
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer upgrading to 0.97+/0.98 with non-empty file_scope stories, I want pending->active and first-adoption paths to accept independently minted human approvals without emptying file_scope, so that the provenance gate protects against self-auth without blocking legitimate activation.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/scope-provenance/evaluate.ts: replace approvalDiskOnly inference that treats missing base active xBRIEF as rewrite; authority = validated base .deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json (schema, human stamp, planId, xbriefRelPath, digest; current record semantically unchanged vs base). Keep same-PR approval rewrite fail-closed.
2. packages/core/src/scope-provenance/evaluate.test.ts (+ optional real-Git fixture test): cover pending->active with base approval pass; missing/mismatched/agent/same-PR rewrite fail; base-approved expansion pass; renewedApprovals still works.
3. Deposit operator surface: packages/cli/src/scope-record-approved-scope.ts (+ test), packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts, tasks/scope.yml verb scope:record-approved-scope wrapping buildApprovedScopeRecord/writeApprovedScopeRecord with humanApproval requirements; refuse agent stamps.
4. content/docs/scope-provenance.md + remediation strings in evaluate.ts: name real command; first-adoption + multi-PR flows.
5. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] #3205. Verify: npm test -w @deftai/directive-core -- --run scope-provenance; npm test -w @deftai/directive-cli -- --run scope-record / verify-scope-provenance.

narrative.Acceptance: Given merge base with pending xBRIEF + valid human-approved path-bound approved-scope record, when branch only activates without changing file_scope or approval, then verify:scope-provenance --base-ref base --enforce exits 0.

items.title: Fail closed on missing or same-PR-rewritten approval

narrative.Acceptance: Given activation with non-empty file_scope when base approval is absent, malformed, agent-stamped, mismatched, or same-change-set rewritten, then gate hard-fails appropriately.
Given separately committed expanded human approval on base, when later PR updates active xBRIEF to that exact scope without rewriting approval in-PR, then gate passes under --enforce.

Given operator mints/renews via deposited scope:record-approved-scope with human stamp, digest file is written correctly; agent stamps refused; remediation and content/docs/scope-provenance.md name the real command and first-adoption/multi-PR flows.
Given PR, regression matrix covered, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3205, review-cycle clean, merge-ready, scope:complete, #3205 closable.
